book.name: 1 CORINTIOS
book.title: U BꞌAXA Uꞌ ITZꞌIBꞌA BꞌEN U PABLO XEꞌ QꞌU NIMAN TETZ U JESUUSTU CORINTO U bꞌaxa uꞌuj uvaꞌ itzꞌibꞌa bꞌen u Pablo te unqꞌa aa Corinto uvaꞌ ni niman u Jesús

content: Niyolon u Pablo tiꞌ u tijleꞌm unqꞌa apóstol

As la pal ex stuul uvaꞌ oꞌ kuxh kꞌameꞌ kꞌatz u Cristo. As aꞌ qijleꞌmeꞌ tiꞌ qalat isuuchil unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnla yoleꞌ uvaꞌ alik kan taꞌn Aak tiꞌ ibꞌanat Aak u nimla bꞌaꞌnileꞌ sqiꞌ uveꞌ Aak kuxh ootzin tetz bꞌaxa.
As la alax te unqꞌa kꞌameꞌ uvaꞌ jik chit itxumbꞌal tiꞌ u taqꞌoneꞌ la ibꞌaneꞌ.
As echeꞌ taꞌ in, tan yeꞌxhkam ni voksa stuul tul nebꞌan unsuuchil. As moj la molol in vatz unqꞌa bꞌanol isuuchil unqꞌa tenameꞌ. As mitaꞌn la unbꞌan jeꞌ unsuuchil.
As kꞌuxh yeꞌxhkam ni tal vaama tiꞌ uvaꞌ kam kat unbꞌana, as jit in la alon moj jik chit vuntxumbꞌaleꞌ nunbꞌaneꞌ tiꞌ u vaqꞌoneꞌ moj yeꞌle. Pet aꞌ u Kubꞌaal Tiixheꞌ la bꞌanon unsuuchil.

Estiꞌeꞌ ni val sete uvaꞌ yeꞌ la ebꞌan isuuchil umaj uxhchil tul uvaꞌ yeꞌxnaj ul u Kubꞌaaleꞌ. Pet lanal ul u Kubꞌaaleꞌ, tan Aakeꞌ tuk aqꞌon veꞌt el tzan unqꞌa txumbꞌaleꞌ skajayil vatz u sajeꞌ uveꞌ yeꞌxhebꞌil ootzin tetz. As Aakeꞌ la kꞌuchun veꞌt el tzan kam uvaꞌ itzꞌamal taꞌn unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ skajayil. As la toksa veꞌt u Tiixheꞌ kuqꞌii skujununilaj jankꞌal oꞌ uvaꞌ qetz chittuꞌ uvaꞌ la ok kuqꞌii.

Vitzꞌin vatzik, ni val unqꞌa yoleꞌ sete sviꞌ tukꞌ tiꞌ u qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ u Apolo. As la etileꞌ kam uvaꞌ nu kubꞌaneꞌ. As la bꞌen sete uvaꞌ yeꞌ la uch epaasat etibꞌ vatz unqꞌa veeꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan. As yeꞌ la ibꞌaneꞌ uvaꞌ la etoksa iqꞌii umaj uxhchil tiꞌ eyansat umaꞌt uxhchil.

¿As kam veꞌt etijleꞌm tiꞌ uvaꞌ nim veꞌt etalcheꞌ tiꞌ vemooleꞌ? ¿As kam unbꞌooj etetz ati uvaꞌ jit u Tiixheꞌ kat aqꞌon? ¿As kam qꞌi uvaꞌ netoksa veꞌt jeꞌ eqꞌii tiꞌ uvaꞌ kat aqꞌax sete? As echeꞌ uvaꞌ ex koj kat chukun sejunal. Pet eela kuxh stukꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌxhkam unbꞌooj kat aqꞌax sete.

As yeꞌl umaꞌtoj txumbꞌal nisaꞌvit setiꞌ, tan at veꞌt etxumbꞌal netaleꞌ, as ex veꞌt ijlenaal nenacheꞌ. Pet ech koj oꞌ sevatz, tan yeꞌl qijleꞌm ati. ¡As ech koj chiteꞌ uvaꞌ ex koj chit ijlenaal, as at qijleꞌm sekꞌatz la ibꞌaneꞌ!

Tan ni vitzꞌa uvaꞌ kat ikꞌuch veꞌt oꞌ u Tiixheꞌ vatz unqꞌa tenameꞌ uvaꞌ echen veꞌt oꞌ timoxtel, tan oꞌ unqꞌa apóstol, as ech ni qulbꞌeleꞌ echeꞌ unqꞌa preexhueꞌ uveꞌ ni talax ikameꞌ. As oꞌ chit nikaꞌya veꞌt oꞌ unqꞌa tenameꞌ tukꞌ unqꞌa ángeleꞌ.

As sevatz tan yeꞌl kutxumbꞌal ati tiꞌ ipaxsal viyol u Cristo. Ech koj ex tan at etxumbꞌal netaleꞌ tiꞌ etok kꞌatz u Cristo. As yeꞌl kuxh iyakꞌil u kuyoleꞌ sevatz. Pet ech koj ex, tan at iyakꞌil veyoleꞌ uveꞌ netaleꞌ. As neteesa kuqꞌii. As netoksa jeꞌ eqꞌii.
As antel kuxh kupalebꞌet vaꞌy tukꞌ tzajitziꞌl cheel. Yeꞌl qoksaꞌm ati. As nu kuxh kuqꞌospeꞌ. As yeꞌl kukabꞌal ati.
As nu kukooleꞌ tiꞌ u qaqꞌoneꞌ tukꞌ u kuqꞌabꞌeꞌ. As bꞌaꞌn kuyoloneꞌ te unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ ni yoqꞌon sqiꞌ. As kuyel kuxh sqaꞌn tul nu kutiluleꞌ.
As kꞌuxh kam kuxh ni talpu sqiꞌ tiꞌ icheesal kupaav as tukꞌ bꞌaꞌnla yol nu kukꞌulbꞌekat. As ech oꞌeꞌ vatz unqꞌa tenameꞌ echeꞌ chꞌis as moj echeꞌ chaꞌxkarat.
Yeꞌle uvaꞌ nu kuxh koj untzꞌibꞌa bꞌen u yoleꞌ sete tiꞌ unchꞌixvisat ex. Pet bꞌeyamal nunbꞌan sete tiꞌ vaqꞌat etxumbꞌal, tan ech exeꞌ echeꞌ meꞌal unkꞌaol, tan xoꞌn chit ex sve.

As kꞌuxh at lavoj mil chusul etetz tiꞌ viyol u Cristoeꞌ, as yeꞌle taꞌ uvaꞌ kalabꞌ kuxh koj ebꞌaal ati kꞌatz u Jesucristoeꞌ, tan in kuxheꞌ in ebꞌaal vatz u Cristoeꞌ tiꞌ unchusat ex tiꞌ u bꞌaꞌnla yoleꞌ bꞌaxa.
Estiꞌeꞌ nunbꞌeya veꞌt sete uvaꞌ ech la ebꞌaneꞌ echeꞌ uveꞌ nunbꞌaneꞌ.

Estiꞌeꞌ kat unchaj bꞌen u Timoteo sexoꞌl, tan ech najeꞌ echeꞌ unkꞌaol uvaꞌ xoꞌn chit sve, tan kꞌujleꞌl chit ikꞌuꞌl tiꞌ u Kubꞌaal Jesúseꞌ. As kꞌujleꞌl unkꞌuꞌl tiꞌ naj. As la tulsa naj sekꞌuꞌl uvaꞌ abꞌiste u txumbꞌaleꞌ uveꞌ eqꞌomal svaꞌn kꞌatz u Kubꞌaal Jesucristoeꞌ. As aꞌ u txumbꞌaleꞌ uveꞌ nunchus veꞌt xoꞌl unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ tu unqꞌa tenameꞌ skajayil.
Pet at kaꞌl ex uvaꞌ netoksa jeꞌ eqꞌii, tan netitzꞌa uvaꞌ yeꞌl in la oon veꞌt in tiꞌ bꞌen unbꞌeyat sete, uveꞌ netaleꞌ.
Asoj la ibꞌan u Kubꞌaal Tiixheꞌ bꞌaꞌnil sve, as la bꞌen vil ex oora. As techal la vootzi ma aꞌ viyakꞌil u Tiixheꞌ netxakonsa. Pet moj etetz kuxh u yoleꞌ uveꞌ netaleꞌ.
As jit kꞌuxh u yoleꞌ tatin u Tiixheꞌ, pet aꞌ u tijleꞌm Aakeꞌ ni kꞌuchun viyakꞌileꞌ.

¿As kam vooneꞌ la oon in sexoꞌl uvaꞌ netaleꞌ? ¿Ma ech vooneꞌ sexoꞌl echeꞌ umaj uxhchil uvaꞌ eqꞌomal umaj tzꞌuꞌm staꞌn tiꞌ ijikbꞌaꞌl vetxumbꞌaleꞌ? ¿Pet moj aꞌ netaleꞌ uvaꞌ bꞌaꞌnla aama in tul uvaꞌ la bꞌen vil ex tiꞌ unxoꞌnit ex?
